review_candidates.title: Technical Security Lead

You will ensure that security technologies, processes, and architecture align with Group standards and regulatory requirements. You must be able to clearly articulate how security technology mitigates specific risks and adds wider business value. What You’ll Be Doing You will own the responsible of the planning and cost of the security technology associated of the SCiN Security Function. You will have solid-line reporting relationship to the Project Security Manager and a strong working relationship with the Team Leads across the Company. Corporate Security / Centre: Alignment with Group Security Standard (GSS). Key Impact: SCiN Security Function credibility and accountability with Business Lead all security technology matters, provide subject matter expertise and guidance to internal stakeholders, and maintain awareness of the external security market, including benchmarking and identifying value-adding technologies and partners. Develop, maintain, and drive the SCiN Security Technology Roadmap, covering prioritization, innovation, and delivery of initiatives from ideation through piloting, onboarding, and company-wide rollout. Collaborate with SCiN IDT, Real Estate, Projects, telecoms, and other disciplines to design, implement, and assure technical security solutions across all sites, including review of engineering and architectural deliverables. Establish, maintain, and refine group technical specifications, standards, tools, processes, and policies (including access control), ensuring alignment with design and delivery requirements. Conduct strategic reviews for high priority/high-risk assets, develop improvement strategies and business cases, and provide SME support through implementation. Ensure all High-Level Security Designs (HLSDs) are fit-for-purpose and compliant; create HLSDs when needed to meet security risk mitigation demands. Provide technical leadership and operational oversight, including acting as functional lead for Genetec system delivery, leading access control operations, and supporting SCiN Security Leadership on enterprise project delivery. Build capability and deliver value by mentoring and training security staff, collaborating with contractors and industry partners for innovative solutions, and driving cost savings through quotation reviews, value engineering, and contract support. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution required; postgraduate qualification in a relevant field is an advantage. At least 5 years of relevant experience, including a minimum of 2 years working with security technology/equipment in top-tier Technology and Consulting firms. Professional industrial security certification (e.g., PSP from ASIS or equivalent) is an advantage. Certification in the use of Genetec Interfaces Good understanding of Exploration & Production (E&P) business, value drivers, and the Nigerian operating environment. Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead integrated teams, delegate effectively, coach team capability, and drive performance, innovation, and new ways of working. Strategic thinker able to advise senior management on threats and mitigation; confident to coordinate and challenge stakeholders on security integration in business proposals. Excellent organizational, analytical, presentation, facilitation, and communication (written and oral) skills; able to work under pressure in multicultural, cross-functional teams with flexibility and accountability. Strong communication skills with the ability to set out logical arguments clearly and adapt language, form, and message to meet the needs of different people/ audiences. Ability to intervene in security-related incidents and uphold security procedures without compromise. The use of collaborative tools including SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Excel is an advantage; HSSE awareness/knowledge required; ability to manage costs and drive cost reduction. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself. Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together. Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead. Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices. Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise. Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working. Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world. Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents. Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply. Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams. Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes. Shell also made history in 2005 when it began production at Bonga, Nigeria’s first deepwater oil. Shell companies and investments have continued to play pioneering roles in onshore, shallow and deepwater oil and gas exploration and production. Shell has been at the forefront of gas development, producing and delivering gas to domestic consumers and export markets for over 40 years. Our values Our core values of honesty, integrity and respect for people form the basis of the Shell General Business Principles. Our contributions Shell Companies in Nigeria (SCiN) are major contributors to the economy, not only through the energy they produce and the revenues they generate for the country, but also via their supply chains, local content and social investment. Nigeria depends on the oil and gas industry for approximately 90% of export income and 75% of overall government revenue. SCiN pursue a variety of social investment projects, with a particular focus on community and enterprise development, education and health. Nigeria is one of the largest concentrations of social investment spending in the Shell Group. Read more about our contributions in Nigeria.

Represent Arrow Mount in meetings with mine managers, procurement executives, contractors and other senior decision-makers. Develop long-term commercial relationships rather than relying solely on one-off sales. 3. WHOLESALE & RETAIL DEVELOPMENT Build a nationwide customer base of hardware stores, industrial suppliers, distributors and other retailers . Develop Arrow Mount's wholesale and distribution strategy. Secure high-volume recurring customers. Develop appropriate pricing, volume and customer acquisition strategies. Identify opportunities for geographic expansion across Zambia. 4. COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT Take responsibility for revenue and gross profit performance. Develop pricing strategies that balance competitiveness with profitability. Establish effective sales processes, reporting systems and customer management practices. Create a performance-driven commercial culture within Arrow Mount. 6. SUPPLIER & STRATEGIC RELATIONSHIPS Develop strong relationships with manufacturers, distributors and strategic suppliers. Identify opportunities for exclusive distribution, agency and strategic supply agreements. Negotiate favourable commercial terms with suppliers. Identify opportunities for partnerships that strengthen Arrow Mount's product offering and market position. An established professional network within Zambia's mining, industrial, construction, hardware or commercial sectors . Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills. Experience managing and developing sales or business development teams. Strong commercial understanding of pricing, margins, profitability and customer credit. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. THE IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for someone who: Knows how to sell. You should be comfortable approaching a potential customer, securing a meeting, understanding their requirements, preparing a commercial solution and closing the business. Knows the mining market. You should understand how mines procure goods and services and have experience navigating procurement departments, supplier registration, RFQs and tenders. Has relationships. You should have an established network that can help Arrow Mount access new customers and opportunities. Has built businesses before. We want evidence of what you have actually achieved, not simply a list of positions held. Is commercially aggressive. You should be driven by targets, revenue, gross profit and customer acquisition. Is hands-on. Arrow Mount is a growing business. The successful candidate will be expected to personally attend meetings, pursue opportunities, negotiate deals and develop customers. FIRST 90 DAYS The successful candidate will be expected to develop and execute a 90-day commercial growth plan , including: Identifying priority mining and industrial customers. Developing a pipeline of potential customers. Securing meetings with key decision-makers. Pursuing supplier registrations with major mines. Identifying tender and RFQ opportunities. Building a network of wholesale and retail customers. Establishing sales targets and reporting systems. Identifying strategic suppliers and commercial partnerships. Generating measurable new business opportunities. QUALIFICATIONS A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field is preferred. The successful candidate will have significant responsibility and the opportunity to directly influence Arrow Mount's customers, revenue, market presence and long-term growth. Competitive remuneration will be offered based on experience and proven capability, with performance-based incentives linked to commercial results. HOW TO APPLY Interested candidates should submit: A detailed CV. A cover letter explaining why they are suitable for the role. A brief summary of their three most significant commercial achievements , including measurable results. Details of relevant experience selling to mines, mining contractors, industrial companies, retailers or distributors. Details of relevant professional networks and markets covered. Applications should be submitted to: Email: info@arrowmount.com Subject: Application – General Manager Only candidates who meet the required experience and commercial profile will be considered.

＜その他補足＞ ■書籍購入制度 ■資格取得制度 ■セミナー参加制度 【休日・休暇 その他】 完全週休2日制（休日は土日祝日） 年間有給休暇13日～20日（下限日数は、入社直後の付与日数となります） 年間休日日数120日 ■年末年始休暇、GW休暇、慶弔休暇、有給休暇、産前・産後休暇、育児休暇、介護休暇 【事業概要】 ■事業内容： ・リーテックスデジタル契約サービスの開発・販売・サポート ・ITインフラとAIテクノロジーを金融、法務、会計の専門知識と融合させた新サービスの提供 ■当社サービスについて 当社で取り扱う電子契約書サービスは、法学者と大手弁護士事務所による監修のもと、業界最高峰の法的安定性を誇るだけでなく、導入コストゼロで業務効率化、印紙税や保管コストの削減を実現するものです。大手銀行や法務部を備えた大手企業など、数多くの企業様に導入いただいた実績に加え、リモートワークの活発化に伴い、さらなる事業拡大を計画中です 【特徴】 （1）最高水準の法的安定性 （2）身元確認で高い証拠力 （3）不正ログイン防止機能 （4）金融機関との連携 （5）契約をペーパーレス化 （6）印紙税を削減 （7）稟議・決裁の電子化 （8）反社勢力との取引排除 ■当社について 当社は「真実の証明」をVISIONとし全ての人が、本来あるべき姿で、法律上の保護を受けられる社会を目指しています 電子契約におけるサービス提供に加え、電子契約を成立させる基幹技術となる電子署名を独自に開発し、ファイナンスのあり方を変えるサービスを提供を構想しています ■当社の強み 電子契約を成立させる基幹技術となる電子署名を独自に開発し、安全性の高い電子契約システムを展開しています 現行の電子署名は数十年もの間、公開鍵暗号（PKI暗号方式）という、暗号化と復号とで異なる2つの鍵（秘密鍵と公開鍵）を使用する方法が一般的です PKI暗号方式は、それぞれが秘密鍵を持つところに、セキュリティの根幹があります。しかし、多くの電子契約で利用されている立会人方式は、同じ秘密鍵を全ユーザーの電子契約で使いまわしているという問題があります そのため、PKI暗号方式の暗号は、量子コンピュータの実用化で解読されると言われています 弊社のワンタイムデジタル署名はブロックチェーン技術を活用した電子署名であり、量子コンピュータでは解読することが難しいと考えています ■今後の展開 連続した電子署名を使用したファクタリング（債権譲渡）のプロダクトをリリース予定です 弊社のプロダクトを通し、連続した電子署名を使用するため、架空売上や二重譲渡のリスクを排除した安全なファクタリングが実現可能となります 【郵便番号】 1600005 【所在地】 東京都新宿区愛住町22 【ビル名等】 第3山田ビル8F 【設立年 補足】 2019年9月 【従業員数】 34名 【市場】 非上場 【資本金】 485百万円 【売上高】 495百万円 【平均年齢】 36歳 【HPリンク先】 https://le-techs.com/
